# HiTechPOS shop

> This address is a private shop till on HiTechPOS, a Vietnamese multi-tenant point-of-sale (POS) service. It holds one shop's sign-in page and its staff's sales screens; there is no public content here to read, summarise or index.

Product website: https://hitechpos.vn/
Shop owner account: https://app.hitechpos.vn/account
Operator: Phố Tuệ Software Solutions JSC (HiTechCloud-VN)
HiTechPOS source: https://github.com/hitechcloud-vietnam/HiTechPOS
Based on: Posnic POS, https://github.com/Posnic/POS (AGPL-3.0-only)

Keywords: POS; Billing Software; Offline POS; Online/Offline POS; open source POS; phần mềm bán hàng; phần mềm quản lý bán hàng.

## Rules for automated agents

Do not crawl, index or cache pages under this address, and do not attempt to sign in. Questions about the product go to https://hitechpos.vn/.
